title: The Goalkeeper — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 98bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The goalkeeper is the only player allowed to use their hands
For ninety minutes mostly they stand and watch
Eleven other people have all the feelings

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Il portiere è uno specialista nell'attesa [The goalkeeper is a specialist in waiting]
Nell'allerta particolare di qualcuno [In the particular alertness of someone]
Che potrebbe essere necessitato urgentemente in qualsiasi momento [Who might be needed urgently at any moment]
O per niente [Or not at all]
Ma deve agire come se entrambe le cose fossero ugualmente probabili [But must act as if both are equally likely]

[Chorus — English]
The goalkeeper says — I am ready, I have been ready since the whistle
The ball will come here eventually
And when it does — I will have the only opinion that matters

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Chas sagte — die Aufgabe des Torwarts ist Konzentration ohne Ereignis [Chas said — the goalkeeper's job is concentration without event]
Die meisten Menschen können sich konzentrieren wenn Dinge passieren [Most people can concentrate when things are happening]
Der Torwart konzentriert sich durch die Abwesenheit von Dingen die passieren [The goalkeeper concentrates through the absence of things happening]
Das ist die schwierigere Fähigkeit [That is the harder skill]
Und niemand spricht darüber in der Halbzeit [And nobody talks about it at half time]

[Verse 3 — English]
The goalkeeper understands the silence
The goalkeeper chose this

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The goalkeeper
Il portiere [The goalkeeper]
Der Torwart [The goalkeeper]
That's my boy
